title: Score each purchase without holding a session

cases.says: a purchase with a low score reaches the deciding participant with its score and is approved
a purchase with a high score reaches the deciding participant with its score and is declined
a purchase waiting for its score gives its session back, so the next purchase is answered meanwhile
the callback finds its own transaction through what it was handed, not through a field the next purchase overwrites
a callback without a score must still resume the transaction, or the purchase is never answered

origin.section: 4.7 `PAUSE` Gives the Session Back While You Wait
